Implemented the IGES CLI in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js), with fixed-format parsing/writing in [output/iges.js](/workspace/output/iges.js), entity PD handling in [output/entityio.js](/workspace/output/entityio.js), and evaluation in [output/evaluator.js](/workspace/output/evaluator.js). I also added workspace entrypoints so `node main.js ...` works via [main.js](/workspace/main.js) and the `iges` binary name is available via [iges](/workspace/iges).

Verified with end-to-end smoke tests: `write`, `parse`, `query`, `eval`, custom Global delimiters, write-side error reporting, and a two-pass `roundtrip` fixed-point check (`roundtrip` output was byte-identical on the second pass).
